Vidit Aatrey, Chairman, Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer at Meesho said, "Our Q2 performance reflects the strength of Meesho's operating model, with NMV growing 23% year-on-year to ₹12,911 crore and Annual Transacting Users reaching 284 million. More consumers are shopping on Meesho, and they are shopping more frequently, even as first-time buyers grew 16% quarter-on-quarter. This momentum extended into the festive season, with NMV growing 33% year-on-year on a festive-aligned basis, reinforcing our conviction in the depth of India's e-commerce opportunity. As we grow, the benefits of scale are increasingly translating into stronger platform economics. Contribution Margin expanded to 6.0% of NMV, driven by logistics efficiencies and improved monetisation. At the same time, AI is fundamentally changing how we build and operate Meesho, with engineering productivity increasing 171% between March and September 2026. Thanking You, Yours truly, For Maruti Suzuki India Limited Sanjeev Grover Executive Officer & Company Secretary Annexure - "A" Press Release Maruti Suzuki India Limited Financial Results Q2 and H1 FY 2026-27 New Delhi, October 27, 2026: The Board of Directors of Maruti Suzuki India Limited (MSIL) today approved the financial results for the period Q2 (July-September) FY 2026-27. Highlights: Q2 (July-September), FY 2026-27 The Company achieved its highest-ever quarterly total sales volume of 696,654 units, registering a growth of 26.5% over the same period previous year. The Company’s growth in the domestic passenger vehicle market was broad-based, with small car sales increasing by 35.9% and SUV sales by 68.2%. The Company’s recently introduced SUVs received a strong market response and contributed to this robust growth. The Company’s domestic market share increased by 2.2 percentage points to 40.8%. Recent capacity additions have enabled the Company to serve the strong demand. Even with enhanced production capacity, demand continued to outpace supply resulting in a low network inventory of about 17 days and pending bookings of about 200,000 units at the end of the quarter. In export markets, despite the challenging geopolitical situation, the Company could achieve sales of 108,119 units in Q2 FY 2026-27, as compared to 110,487 units in Q2 FY25-26. During the quarter, the Company registered its highest-ever Net Sales of INR 506,155 million against INR 401,358 million in the same period of the previous year. The Operating Profit (EBIT) in the quarter stood at INR 28,037 million as compared to INR 33,820 million in Q2 FY25-26 owing to West-Asia conflict linked commodity increases. Sequentially this translated to a growth of 10.8% from Q1 FY26-27 to Q2 FY26-27. However, non-operating income declined sharply in Q2 owing to mark-to-market losses on invested surplus. With this, the Net Profit for the quarter stood at INR 24,149 million compared to INR 33,028 million the same period previous year. Highlights: H1 (April-September), FY 2026-27 During this period, the Company achieved its highest-ever half-yearly sales volume of 1,379,378 units, registering a growth of 27.9% year-on-year. This comprised record half-yearly domestic sales of 1,146,523 units and exports of 232,855 units. The Company posted its highest-ever half-yearly Net Sales of INR 1,005,746 million in H1 FY 2026-27 as compared to INR 767,564 million in H1 FY 2025-26. Net Profit in H1 FY 2026-27 was at INR 57,670 million as against INR 70,609 million in H1 FY 2025-26. The DW-220 combines heavy-duty excavation capability with precision- oriented verticality control. It supports excavation depths of up to 32 metres, delivers a specified 120-ton grab closing force, and offers bucket capacities from 0.8 to 1.3 cubic metres. Bucket widths of 500, 600, 800 and 1,000 mm provide flexibility across excavation requirements. A heavy-duty square telescopic Kelly bar supports deep trench excavation, while the Kelly housing guides vertical alignment. The parallelogram structure and hydraulic cylinders help maintain grab verticality, mast position and operating stability. A wide-track, heavy- duty crawler undercarriage provides a stable base for demanding site conditions. The hydraulic grab incorporates powerful closing cylinders and wear- resistant teeth. Its 320-bar hydraulic system and Isuzu diesel engine support demanding operations. An automatic hydraulic hose reel, rotating wire-rope pulley, galvanized wire rope and single-layer drum DW-220 Hydraulic Diaphragm Wall Grab support-controlled hose and rope management. CIN: L45205TN1995PLC030231 | Tel: +91 44 6123 2323 | www.wabag.com WABAG secures order from RIL to deliver ‘Mega’ Desalination Plant and Remineralisation Plant at Jamnagar Chennai, October 27, 2026: VA TECH WABAG (‘WABAG’), a leading Pure-Play Multinational Water Technology Group, secured a ‘Mega’ order from Reliance Industries Limited (‘RIL’) towards Design, Engineering, Supply, Installation, Pre-Commissioning, Commissioning and Performance Guarantee Test Run (PGTR) of a Desalination Plant with a capacity of 8,400 m3/hr, expandable to 12,600 m3/hr (302 MLD) and a 3,000 m3/hr Remineralization Plant at Jamnagar, Gujarat. The proposed Desalination Plant will comprise Lamella Clarifiers, Dissolved Air Flotation Filters (DAFF), an Ultra Filtration (UF) system, along with an associated chemical dosing and backwash systems, followed by Sea Water Reverse Osmosis (SWRO) and Brackish Water Reverse Osmosis (BWRO) Systems with dosing, product water storage and brine outfall pumping systems. The Remineralization Plant will comprise of limestone filters, lime handling system, carbon dioxide storage and dosing system, and storage and pumping system. Commenting on the order win, Mr. S. Natrajan – Vice President & Head Sales & Marketing, said, “This Mega order reinforces RIL’s confidence in WABAG’s proven technology and strong execution record. It further enhances our presence in the global desalination market and demonstrates our capacity and capability to deliver large-scale, technology-led water infrastructure.” Order Classification Small Medium Large Major Mega Domestic (in INR Crores) Upto 100 100 to 250 250 to 600 600 to 1,000 Above 1,000 International (In USD Millions) Upto
